part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `getTypeParamExpressions` in src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleSuperBuilder.java:1111 — when a superclass type argument is an annotated type (e.g. `Parent<@ValidDouble Double>`), the `JCAnnotatedType` node wasn't handled and was silently dropped, so the generated builder's extends clause lost a type argument (`ParentBuilder<C, B>` instead of `ParentBuilder<Double, C, B>`). The fix clones the annotated type (via the reflective `JCAnnotatedTypeReflect` helper, since lombok compiles against old javac APIs) and passes it through to the generated builder.

`ant test.instance` now passes all 412 tests, including the previously failing `SuperBuilderWithAnnotatedTypeParam` delombok test.
